author: Harris & Ewing
rights_note: US copyright registration H105262 in 1908; term expired. Wikimedia Commons reproduces the LOC catalogue and identifies the image as public domain. Texture derivation reviewed for this personal-photo preview; the public-domain original is the basis, not an unrelated face dataset.
access_notes: LOC direct access returned HTTP 403. Catalogue metadata and image retrieved via Wikimedia Commons file page, cross-checked with the Glessner House Museum article Mrs. Pullman in Washington, D.C. (6 July 2015). The latter identifies the mother of Florence Pullman Lowden, not a younger Mrs. Pullman. This 1908 picture is four years later than the scene.
